campaign_mix: one hidden world of each of the six kinds per campaign (v0.2 generator, unchanged)

custody.label: SELF_ADMINISTERED
custody.root: the owner writes 32 random bytes to a 0600 file outside the tree before the run; the driver writes its SHA-256 commitment before the first campaign; revealed only after every campaign is sealed

isolation.boundary_claim: at most OS_ISOLATION_BOUNDARY_VERIFIED for this host and configuration, through the per-process records; never container or host level
isolation.label: os_isolated_per_universe
isolation.record_rule: six passing outside verifications per VALID record

A1-pysr-units-dev-pilot.what: EXC-5 exit: pysr_units development pilot (fresh dev root, under isolation) and QUALIFIED / NOT_QUALIFIED record

A1b-proposer-env.what: the formal proposer environment and exposures fixed here and checked by the formal driver (G7 pilot: JULIA_DEPOT_PATH with a read-only depot under /opt, PYTHON_JULIACALL_PROJECT/EXE, PYTHON_JULIAPKG_OFFLINE, JULIA_NUM_THREADS)

A6-cost.what: isolated per-universe cost at the 10-campaign rung, BLAS 1, 4 workers; ESTIMATE with interval for the formal grid

D12-codex-review.what: independent (Codex) review of this preregistration, findings closed

D15-crash-classification.what: owner decision: a proposer crash or timeout after its outside verification is infrastructure (A), the arm's failure (B) or mixed (C), plus a per-root attempt ledger

M-d-candidate-registration.what: a registration path for a candidate arm with its own identity binding; Step 1 needs none, a Step 2 lift decision does

OD-18-budget.what: owner sets the wall-clock cap at launch (D5)

multiplicity-iut.what: proposal: replace holm_family by iut_all (valid at alpha without correction and compares every arm); D9 stands until the owner decides

review-12b-margin.what: owner reading: control-kind non-inferiority margin 0.10 vs P-1 'no loss allowed in control cells'

out_of_scope.dynamics: PySINDy runs over an algebraic log-monomial library
out_of_scope.experiment_selection_by_information_gain: not implemented; only credit is scored
out_of_scope.llm_ablation: Step 2 requirement; no LLM proposer exists
out_of_scope.rule: a class without a strong applicable baseline supports no lift claim

owner_decisions.D10: FDA-06 cap on every law kind + out-of-family secondary endpoint
owner_decisions.D13: region tell disclosed and stratified (option C)
owner_decisions.D9: empirical-Bernstein, Holm over the pre-declared family

run_rules.deadline: a run that misses its cap is incomplete: it supports no Step 1 gate decision; a rerun needs a fresh root
run_rules.deviations: any change after freezing is a new version, never an edit
run_rules.invalid_world_sets: any INVALID_BENCHMARK world set blocks the Step 2 decision on that grid
run_rules.tier: formal requires a clean tree and this document frozen with a matching digest

statistics.cap: FDA-06: every law kind capped at the comparator where no baseline family represents the truth
statistics.decision_entry: benchmarks/genesis_lite/decide_v4.py (roles frozen in code, grid from the commitment)
statistics.endpoint: six-kind credit sum in [-6, 6]; paired differences in [-12, 12]
statistics.inference: empirical-Bernstein lower bound and its p-value (Maurer & Pontil 2009, Thm 4), alpha 0.05; the bootstrap tail and the sign-flip test are not used
statistics.power_note: docs/work/proposals/BLINDFOLD_V04_POWER_AND_INFERENCE_DRAFT.md: at 2400 units the bound detects about 0.18 per unit with k = 3 (development estimate)
statistics.step_1_reports: baseline distributions per arm, per kind and per stratum; Step 1 tests no lift
statistics.unit: one world set = one campaign (six worlds) under one (campaign, presentation, seed) master seed; units independent (fresh worlds, one stateless isolated proposer per universe)

step: Genesis §18 Step 1: frozen roster, baseline distributions over >= 20 seeds; no Mind arm (D1)

strata_disclosures.extended_region_refusal: development finding: on extended regions the gated arms score 0 on discoverable and spurious_correlate (they never extrapolate)
strata_disclosures.region_tell: D13 option C: indistinguishable worlds always have an extended region, others half the time; reported by region and kind
strata_disclosures.representation_circularity: EXC-4b: 89/120 discoverable laws expressible by the five-shape grammar; three shapes overlap the generator's families; reported by representation
